scope: Exhaustive routing plan from existing evidence, not complete semantic qualification or a new public projection. Each field is assigned one provisional destination and a review disposition. Existing mapping is adapter evidence, not live use.

policy.clinical_reporting_context: Clinical quality and reporting context only; never a building/environmental score by default.
policy.resident_census_context: Reported resident census; not licensed or installed capacity.
policy.workforce_context: Separate raw/adjusted FTE, hours and turnover. No unqualified sums.
policy.reported_capacity: Source-specific unit, applicability and outlier review before aggregation.
policy.building_infrastructure: Snapshot-reported infrastructure, not verified inspection or current condition.
policy.organization_context: Separate legal/operational roles, source-family IDs and history; not legal title.
policy.reported_services: Source-reported provision, not installed equipment, vendor contract or procurement intent.
policy.historical_regulatory_context: Preserve survey date/type, correction state and reporting limits; no current violation inference.
policy.laboratory_quantity_context: Do not add overlapping test volumes or equate them with analyzer counts.
policy.no_observed_values: Do not coerce missing to zero.
policy.unresolved: No promotion until exact meaning and applicable domain are qualified.
